subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should OpenClaw accept loopback-only Anthropic OAuth callback hosts and derived redirect URIs as the supported behavior, despite breaking non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST setups?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it intentionally changes an existing env-var/auth-provider behavior and the security boundary needs maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
options.body: Approve the fail-closed validation because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI OAuth shape and the implementation matches the sibling OAuth pattern.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Anthropic token-exchange proof before accepting provider-side redirect registration risk for every allowed loopback spelling.

options.title: Pause For OAuth Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer removing or deprecating the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed validation because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI OAuth shape and the implementation matches the sibling OAuth pattern.
